exceptions.cause: Pins the version-1 addendum schema text active before the v2 amendment edited its frozen.description annotation; addendum-v1.schema.json archives the post-edit, pre-v2-amendment text instead, per amendment-v2.md. The two texts differ only in that annotation string (no $id, const, enum, required, or numeric-bound difference), so every instance either accepts or rejects is identical under both.
